# Melbourne Print & Publish

> Melbourne Print & Publish is a full-service book publishing company based in Melbourne, Australia. We help authors bring their books to life with professional publishing, editing, ghostwriting, book design, and marketing services across all genres including fiction, non-fiction, and specialised categories.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/): Homepage of Melbourne Print & Publish — professional printing and publishing company in Melbourne.
- [About Us](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/about-us/): Learn about Melbourne Print & Publish, our team, mission, and publishing experience.
- [Blog](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/blog/): Articles, guides, and insights on publishing, writing, and the book industry in Australia.
- [Portfolios](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/portfolios/): Browse our portfolio of published books across various genres and categories.
- [Website Portfolio](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/website-portfolio/): Explore author websites designed and developed by Melbourne Print & Publish.
- [Contact Us](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/contact-us/): Get in touch with Melbourne Print & Publish for inquiries, quotes, or publishing consultations.
- [Testimonials](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/testimonial/): Read reviews and testimonials from authors who have published with us.

## Service Pages

- [Book Design](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/book-design/): Professional book cover design and interior layout services for print and digital formats.
- [Ghost Writing](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/ghost-writing/): Expert ghostwriting services to help bring your story or ideas to life.
- [Marketing](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/marketing/): Book marketing and promotion strategies to help your book reach its target audience.
- [Professional Editing](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/professional-editing/): Comprehensive editing services including developmental editing, copy editing, and proofreading.
- [Publishing](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/publishing/): End-to-end book publishing services with global distribution for self-published and independent authors.
- [Non-Fiction Ghostwriting Service](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/non-fiction-ghostwriting-service-in-melbourne/): Professional non-fiction ghostwriting services in Melbourne for memoirs, business books, self-help, and more.
- [Fiction Ghostwriting Services](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/fiction-ghostwriting-services-in-melbourne/): Fiction ghostwriting services in Melbourne for novels across every genre, length, and style.
- [eBook Writing Services](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/e-book-writing-services-in-melbourne/): Professional eBook writing services in Melbourne for authors, entrepreneurs, and professionals.
- [Book Proofreading Services](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/book-proofreading-services-in-melbourne/): Book proofreading services in Melbourne to catch errors and ensure a polished, publish-ready manuscript.
- [Book Formatting Services](https://melbourneprintpublish.com.au/book-formatting-services-in-melbourne/): Professional book formatting services in Melbourne for print and digital platforms.
